name: Jin Lianqin
current_role: Director and largest shareholder (~29.9%), Jiangsu Changqingshu New Materials Technology Co. (Changqing Technology, SSE: 603125)
profile: Jin Lianqin (金连琴), 59, is a director and co-controlling shareholder (with her husband, chairman Sun Qiuxin) of Zhenjiang-based Changqing Technology, a maker of specialty monomers and polymer additives that listed on the Shanghai main board in April 2023. She also heads Xinxin Oil Products and is GM of Zhenjiang Baoju Oil Additives.
interesting_fact: Changqing's predecessor was set up in June 2010 as a wholly foreign-owned enterprise held via a British nominee, Alan David Pow, on Sun Qiuxin's behalf to fit local investment-attraction policy; the nominee arrangement was unwound in Dec 2011.
deep_cut_fact: Before chemicals, she spent 13 years (1990-2003) as a clinical lab staffer in the testing department of the Danmian Group staff hospital, then worked in the lab of Danyang Yunyang People's Hospital until 2006.
notes: Hurun 'Changqing' = Changqing Technology (常青科技, 603125), not Changqing Agrochemical (002391). Low public profile; best route is the company securities office (board secretary).
